verdict: Provide one editable Preparation entry for a job description or task languages. Start activates it in memory and returns to Listen. Full Quit and relaunch clear active context; saved templates, prompts and projects remain separate. Platform, position and focus stay editable. Requirements guide answers and do not establish personal expertise.
why: The user wants lightweight task-specific preparation only for the current session. This replaces the previously persisted active preparation and initial architecture selection. Reusable templates may remain optional.

decided.quote: [English translation] Enter the job description or coding languages for this task, press Start and return to Listen. It is active for the current session; when I really quit the program, reset it.
